headline_aim: Build heavy industry with Soviet help
outcome_note: Industrial base built. Agricultural output passed prewar levels.

headline_aim: Great Leap Forward: overtake Britain in steel
outcome_note: Agricultural output target was plus 270 percent. Actual gain was 35 percent. Famine followed.

headline_aim: Defense and Third Front inland industry
outcome_note: Plan delayed by the aftermath of the Great Leap. Defense became the priority.

headline_aim: Small scale, local, labor intensive projects
outcome_note: Decentralized approach. Growth continued but the economy stayed poor.

headline_aim: Ten year outline, then readjustment and reform
outcome_note: Original steel and oil targets were impossible and were cut. Dec 1978 plenum shifted focus to modernization.
First plan to support solar panel manufacturing. Reform era growth took off.
Coast led, inland supported the coast. Inflation and Tiananmen slowed the end of the period.
Deng 1992 southern tour relaunched reform. Growth averaged over 12 percent a year (World Bank).

headline_aim: Quadruple 1980 GDP by 2000, state firm reform
outcome_note: State firms shed tens of millions of jobs. Asian financial crisis hit 1997 to 1998.
China joined the WTO in Dec 2001. Growth averaged about 9.8 percent a year (World Bank).
GDP growth averaged 11.2 percent. Energy intensity fell 19.1 percent, just short of 20 percent.
GDP growth averaged about 7.8 percent. Energy intensity fell 18.2 percent, beating the target.

headline_aim: Moderately prosperous society, Made in China 2025
outcome_note: GDP growth averaged about 5.7 percent (World Bank), below target, COVID hit 2020. Energy intensity fell about 13.8 percent, missing 15 percent. Carbon intensity fell about 22 percent, beating 18 percent.
